notes: New Sound card in Settings: pick where the engineer voice plays, the radio beep style and volume and an end-of-message sound. Much faster spotter: calls now come within a few hundredths of a second instead of up to two seconds late, shorter calls, no beep. The engineer talks less in practice and qualifying: car ahead or behind calls at most once a lap and the same message at most once in five minutes. Corners fixed: 47 tracks including Barcelona, Zandvoort, COTA, Le Mans, Imola and Laguna Seca had no live corners since 2.28.5, some tracks got the wrong layout, and That was turn N named the previous corner. Le Mans Ultimate and rF2 spotter read the wrong data since 2.28.5 - left and right are fixed. iRacing: no more Clear air both ways every 28 seconds. Community reference laps: only clean laps count, correct car classes, layouts kept apart. Speech recognition no longer crashes when your Windows user name has accents, quiet 8-bit microphones work again, the voice falls back to the default device when the chosen one fails, and a missing output device is reported. Setup advice updated: smaller brake bias steps, one anti-roll bar click at a time, ACC pressure window 26.0-27.0 psi, the LMU and rF2 pressure hint now works. Wheels: no more Error creating window handle at startup. This was checked in demo mode and tests, not yet out on track - if something sounds off, please use the feedback form in the app.
